desc: E12 (m1n1-side): Linux issues Identify and keeps a live depth-2 admin queue alongside I/O, sharing the NVMMU TCB table; m1n1 issues neither after init. Add an Identify (and optionally periodic admin commands) to the m1n1 probe before/during --wrap-march. If the assert appears, concurrent admin+IO traffic through the shared NVMMU is the trigger. Depends on 194 being negative.
